_about: Public-domain Philip Doddridge (1702-1751, Northampton Dissenting academy) for the Word Hoard. Three titles clean from CCEL, the Life of Colonel Gardiner from Gutenberg, and the Works (Leeds: Edward Baines, 1802-1805, 10 vols, the Princeton Seminary scans, vol. X from a Google scan; volume numbers read off the title pages) as raw Internet Archive OCR. His hymns belong to the hymn manifest. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
